_notice: FICTITIOUS. Generated approved emails from representatives who do not exist to prescribers who do not exist, about a product that does not exist. Addresses use .example.
usage: One record per approved email a representative sent a generated prescriber between 2026-01-01 and the as_of date, from a template in crm/approved-emails.json, by the representative whose territory (crm/field-force.json) covers the prescriber's state. events lists delivery, opens, clicks (with the portal page linked), bounces and unsubscribes, with UTC times. hcps.json holds each prescriber's email consent at the start of this log; an unsubscribe here ends it (engagement/campaign-rules.json ENG-12). Opens within 5 seconds of delivery are privacy-proxy prefetches and clicks within 10 seconds, before any human open, are security scanners (ENG-13); both carry machine: true and neither counts as engagement.

quality_flags.email_without_consent: Sent to a prescriber without approved-email consent, or after they unsubscribed (ENG-12).
quality_flags.email_to_inactive: Sent to a retired prescriber or one whose NPI had been deactivated (ENG-12).
quality_flags.email_outside_territory: Sent by a representative whose territory does not cover the prescriber's state (ENG-12).
